t: Do not attach a condition to your request
a: لاَ يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي، إِنْ شِئْتَ. لِيَعْزِمِ الْمَسْأَلَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ مُكْرِهَ لَهُ
m: None of you should say: O Allah forgive me if You wish, O Allah have mercy on me if You wish. Let him be firm in his asking, for no one compels Him.
